synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-4/y+4, A3 apart, A4 together; each block blocked independently by half bounds, marker cells, maze.
Click marker -> armed (blocks become color_1 players, clicked marker active); A1-4 move active marker by 4; click other marker switches, click player disarms (players -> blocks by x half); clicks on the active marker or a block do nothing.
Timer bars color_0 at (64-w,0) and (0,63), w=floor(3(n+1)/7), n=actions incl. no-ops; continuity-gated, fallback n=smallest with that width (0 if no bar).
Names = type_color_rank by (y,x); ranks start at 2 in block mode (blocks keep fixed names), 0 in armed mode.
Unconfirmed: maze cells {(6,18),(14,38),(38,14)} inferred only from blocked moves; other invisible maze cells unknown.
